title_en: Launch of the SNU Credit Exchange Portal
summary: The University has opened the SNU Credit Exchange (「SNU 학점교류」) portal, which gathers recruitment information for exchange study at other universities in Korea. Students are encouraged, but not required, to use the portal at https://exchange.snu.ac.kr or through the mySNU portal. No deadline is stated.
applies_to: Students of this university (Seoul National University) interested in exchange study at other universities in Korea. Use of the portal is encouraged, not mandatory.
steps: Read Attachment 1 (SNU Credit Exchange Portal Usage Guide) and Attachment 2 (Seoul National University Credit Exchange Portal Manual for Students); their contents were not read for this translation.
Open the SNU Credit Exchange portal at https://exchange.snu.ac.kr, or through the top menu of the mySNU portal, or through "SNU 학점교류" under '이런 서비스 어떠세요?' (How about these services?) in mySNU.
Search exchange study recruitment notices from other universities in Korea by condition, set your regions, consortia and universities of interest, and scrap notices to receive alerts of new notices.
For questions, contact the Academic Affairs Office (학사과); the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Launch of the 「SNU Credit Exchange」 (「SNU 학점교류」) Portal

To provide students of this university with systematic information on recruitment for exchange study at other universities in Korea and to improve students' access to that information, the University has opened the 「SNU Credit Exchange」 portal, as described below. Students are encouraged to make use of it.

A. System address: SNU Credit Exchange (https://exchange.snu.ac.kr)
※ The portal can also be accessed through the top menu of the mySNU portal, or through "SNU 학점교류" (SNU Credit Exchange) under '이런 서비스 어떠세요?' (How about these services?).

B. Main functions
1) Provides recruitment information for exchange study at other universities in Korea and supports searching by condition.
2) Allows setting regions, consortia and universities of interest, scrapping notices, and receiving alerts of new notices from universities of interest.
3) Manages records of participation in exchange study at other universities in Korea.

C. Inquiries: Academic Affairs Office (학사과). The contact details are in the original notice.

Attachments (2)
Attachment 1. SNU Credit Exchange Portal Usage Guide (SNU 학점교류 포털 활용 안내.hwp, 1 MB)
Attachment 2. Seoul National University Credit Exchange Portal Manual for Students (서울대학교 학점교류포털 매뉴얼_학생.pdf, 5 MB)

(The contents of the attachments were not read for this translation.)
